paite: Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip hi; la ka sa ding, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding, ka thupina teng toh.
heading: David phatna La / Melmate Dou Dia Panpihna Ngetna
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

paite: Pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zaw zingkhang in ka halh ding.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

paite: TOUPA aw, michih lakte ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; mite lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

paite: Na zahngaihna van khup in athupi a, na thutak in vandumte asun hial hi.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, nang van khen ah pahtawi in hong om in; na thupinate leitung tengteng tung ah pahtawi in om hen.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

paite: Na deihtakte humbit a a-omtheihna ding un, na khut taklam in hondam inla, hon dawng in.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

paite: Pathian in asianthouna ah hiai bang in agen a, Nuam ka sa ding; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth Phaizang ka hawmzak ding.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

paite: Gilead gam kei a ahi a; Manasseh gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

paite: Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi a; Edom gam ah ka khedap ka pai ding a; Philistia gam ka kikoukhum ding hi.
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

paite: Khopi kulh nei ah kua'n ahon pilut dia? Edom gam ah kua'n ahon pi dia?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

paite: Pathian aw, nang hon khahkhia hilou na hi maw? Pathian aw, ka sepaihhonte uh kiang ah lah na pawt ngal kei a.
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

paite: Galte sual ding in hon panpih in; mihing panpihna zaw bangmah lou phet ahi.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

paite: Pathian ziak in hangtak in ka hih ding uh; amah lah hon doute sikdenpa ding ahi ngal a.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
